name: Shin'en no Reconquista
source:
Command an army of chaos numbering over ten thousand and conquer the world!!

This game is a strategic simulation where the Demon King, freed from a thousand-year seal, wages war against three races—humans, elves, and dwarves—to dominate the world.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ106891.html/]dlsite[/url]]
